title.narrative: HeatHeart: supporting 2024-2025 winter plan in the most critical winter heating needs

description.narrative: ltpgtR2P is proposing to cover the most critical winter heating needs in supporting the 2024 -2025 winter plan in Ukraine, which are reported by many individuals as the dire need of mitigating the impacts of harsh winter weather. R2P will work on providing heating activities for winter season to the most vulnerable individuals - especially women, elderly, children and persons with disabilities living in households in Kharkiv and Dnipro oblasts (for hosted communities, returnees, IDPs, evacuees) and for people living in Collective Centers in Kharkiv, Dnipro, Vinnitsa, Cherkasy, Poltava oblasts. lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtThe assistance for households will be provided in two modalities: solid fuel (briquettes) distribution and cash for utilities for households with centralized gas systems.ltbrgtIn each of the target oblasts R2P will select households with a strong focus on the vulnerability: ltbrgt-Households leaded by woman/or man with children ltbrgt-Single-headed households ltbrgt-Households with pregnant/lactating women ltbrgt-Households with adopted child/children ltbrgt-Households with elderly (including single / elderly-headed households) lt/pgtltpgt-Households with disabled (mental or physical) members or members with chronic illness/medical conditions lt/pgtltpgt-Highly vulnerable IDP/evacuees households. ltbrgtR2P selected three hromadas in Kharkiv and Dnipro regions according to SNFI Cluster geography mapping. ltbrgt- Kharkivska oblast: Malynivska hromada (Chuhuivsky rajon) ltbrgt- Dnipropetrovska oblast:Pokrovska hromada (Synelnykivsky rajon) and Myrivska hromada (Nikopolskiy rajon).ltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtIn addition, R2P will cover the most critical winter heating needs for people living in Collective Centers in Kharkiv, Dnipro, Vinnitsa, Cherkasy, Poltava oblasts. lt/pgtltpgtR2P will provide winter fuel for generators of 18 selected Collective Centers.lt/pgtltpgtR2P will prioritize small repair works (installation or replacement of windows and doors) to improve the living conditions and thermal envelope for 35 Collective Centers. A final list of CC will be agreed and approved by CCCM Cluster before the repair works will start.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtThe project is designed to respond to the most critical winter heating needs as identified and recommended by Inter-Cluster Coordination Group (ICCG) under the 2024 Ukraine Humanitarian Needs and Response Plan (HNRP), the Camp Coordination and Camp Management (CCCM) Cluster Winter Plan 2024-2025 and complements the Government’s response. The project will be implemented in partnership with local authorities and coordinate with development and humanitarian aid programmes to support stabilization, and facilitate a more sustainable response to the upcoming winter cold season, taking into consideration the cross-cutting priorities, including gender and age, disability inclusion, protection mainstreaming, and accountability.lt/pgt
